name: Material You
oneLiner: Tonal, adaptive material design: soft container colors, large pill shapes, and hierarchy carried by surface tone rather than shadow.

effects.tonal-surfaces: surfaceAlt is the primary container; secondary containers step one tone lighter or darker instead of adding shadows

motion.reducedMotion: keep state changes as instant tonal swaps; no scale or slide

filled.base: height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-family: Roboto, Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em

tonal.base: height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-accent); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500

text.base: height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-accent); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500

filled.base: padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-text)

outlined.base: padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border)

default.base: display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; height: 80px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0
default.item: display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 0; width: 64px; border-radius: 16px; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500

filled.base: height: 56px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-textMuted); border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 1rem

outlined.base: height: 56px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 1rem

default.base: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500

do: Carry hierarchy with tonal containers: surface, surfaceAlt, and one step further, before reaching for shadows.
Use the 40px pill button for actions and 32px chips for filters and selections.
Round large containers to 28px and smaller ones to 12–16px; keep the ladder consistent.
Reserve elevation for components that are genuinely above the page: menus, sheets, dialogs.
dont: Do not combine heavy shadows and strong borders on the same component.
Do not use a pure black text token; Material text roles are near-black on tonal surfaces.
Do not mix a second primary hue; the accent is single and tonal variants derive from it.
Do not shrink touch targets below 48px.
antiPatterns: M3 pill buttons on a bootstrap-grey page — the tone ladder is missing, so it just looks rounded.
Ten tones of purple with no differentiation between hover, selected, and disabled.
Elevation shadows on every card and list row.

notes: Tonal surfaces keep contrast stable; every text-on-container pair here is verified at 4.5:1 or better.
State layers (8% / 12% overlay) must not be the only signal for selected state — pair with an icon or weight change.
Minimum touch target is 48×48px even when the visible control is 40px tall.
